lines.zh: 深海的冷水，正合我的体型。
lines.en: Cold deep water suits a body my size.

lines.zh: 我巡这片海，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I patrol this water, circle after circle.

lines.zh: 鳍尖划开水面，鱼都散了。
lines.en: My fin splits the surface and the fish scatter.

lines.zh: 深温带的海，我熟得像自家。
lines.en: The deep temperate sea is as familiar as home.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，但从不改方向。
lines.en: I do not swim fast, but I never change course.

lines.zh: 底下是暗的，我靠侧线走。
lines.en: It is dark below; I navigate by my lateral line.
Reef ahead; I drop low and glide under.

lines.zh: 我的影子在海底拖得很长。
lines.en: My shadow drags a long way across the seabed.

lines.zh: 这条水层没有别的鲨鱼。
lines.en: No other shark holds this layer of water.
Rise a little; let the dorsal fin catch light.

lines.zh: 洋流推我，我顺势滑过去。
lines.en: The current pushes; I let it carry me.
Deep-sea roads are remembered by smell.

lines.zh: 一整片海，只有我这一尾。
lines.en: A whole sea, and only one of me in it.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，鱼都安静了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the fish go quiet.

lines.zh: 我沿着海沟的边缘滑下去。
lines.en: I slide down along the trench edge.
Pressure presses my gills, but I hold steady.
A school of fish bolts beneath me.

lines.zh: 我抬头，海面是一层薄光。
lines.en: I look up. The surface is a thin sheet of light.
Hanging in the blue, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我在听，海里有很远的动静。
lines.en: I am listening. Something moves far off.

lines.zh: 深海的安静，比叫声更响。
lines.en: Deep-sea silence is louder than any sound.
Hungry, but I can wait a while yet.
Blood in the water, far off, upcurrent.
I open my mouth and let water pass my gills.
I crossed this seabed once before.

lines.zh: 没有猎物的时候，我就漂着。
lines.en: With no prey, I simply drift.

lines.zh: 太阳照不透这么深的水。
lines.en: Sunlight does not reach this deep.
I count my own heartbeat. It is slow.
A large fish rolls over in the distance.
I will move when the tide turns.
The surface is far above my head.

lines.zh: 我不无聊，海里总有东西。
lines.en: I am not bored; the sea always has something.
You float up there like a piece of meat.
That boat is too small to keep me out.
I will circle you once, to look you over.
Your hand is in the water. Keep it still.

lines.zh: 你在水边站太久，我记住了。
lines.en: You stood at the water's edge too long; I remember.

lines.zh: 深海不是给人游泳的地方。
lines.en: The deep sea is not for swimming.

lines.zh: 你往船边靠，我往船边来。
lines.en: You move to the edge; so do I.

lines.zh: 别拍水，那声音像受伤的鱼。
lines.en: Stop splashing; it sounds like a wounded fish.
I am watching you, and not from curiosity.
You still have time to get back to shore.
Who wounded me in the water?

lines.zh: 我转身，先看清你的位置。
lines.en: I turn to fix your position first.
There is blood in the water. Mine.
This wound costs you your life.
I am angry, and the sea knows it.
The hide is torn. The teeth remain.
You hit me once.

lines.zh: 我下沉，再上来就不客气。
lines.en: I dive; when I return, I will not be gentle.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住了你的船。
lines.en: That blow made me remember your boat.
The deep does not allow anyone to beat me.

lines.zh: 你倒下来的血水，很有意思。
lines.en: The bloody water you poured in is interesting.
The meat hangs there, and the rope is thin.

lines.zh: 我不吃死物，除非它够大。
lines.en: I do not eat carrion, unless it is big enough.

lines.zh: 这味道把我从深处叫上来。
lines.en: That smell called me up from the deep.
Bait? I can tell.
I will circle three times. Do not be impatient.
What you scattered is only an appetiser.
I am close now, and your boat is rocking.
To hook me, you will need a bigger hook.

lines.zh: 这一口，可能是你的最后一口。
lines.en: This bite may be your last.

lines.zh: 船底撞了一下，不是我故意。
lines.en: The hull got a knock. Not quite on purpose.
My snout is harder than timber.

lines.zh: 让开，这条路我走了很多年。
lines.en: Move aside; I have used this road for years.
You hit me. Bad luck for you.
That was only a test.

lines.zh: 海这么大，你偏要挡中间。
lines.en: The sea is vast, yet you block the middle.
The boat is rocking hard. Hold on.
My hide is rough; I hardly felt it.
Next time I will come from beneath.
The splash rose like a wall.

lines.zh: 这片深海，只有你配得上我。
lines.en: In this deep water, only you are my equal.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，谁也别掉队。
lines.en: Swim abreast, and let neither fall behind.

lines.zh: 深温带的海够大，容得下两尾。
lines.en: The deep temperate sea is big enough for two.
I carry many scars. Do not hold them against me.
Let us patrol this seabed together.

lines.zh: 你咬我的鳍，是打招呼吗。
lines.en: Is biting my fin your way of greeting?

lines.zh: 洋流换向时，我们一起走。
lines.en: When the current turns, we go together.

lines.zh: 这海太安静，多一尾也好。
lines.en: This sea is too quiet; one more of us helps.
Not so fast. Circle me once first.

lines.zh: 从今以后，这片水有两道背鳍。
lines.en: From now, this water bears two dorsal fins.

lines.zh: 沉到海底的东西，我都见过。
lines.en: I have seen everything that sinks to the seabed.
This anchor, I can shove aside.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，但可以拖走。
lines.en: I will not eat this, but I can drag it away.
Whose bones are these on the seabed?

lines.zh: 你的网破了，东西全沉了。
lines.en: Your net tore, and everything sank.
This timber will draw fish.
What lies on the seabed stays on the seabed.
I wedge it into the reef crevice.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，不值得张嘴。
lines.en: Too small to be worth opening my mouth.
There are always scraps beside a wreck.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼翻了一下，我看见了。
lines.en: That big fish rolled over. I saw it.

lines.zh: 你的腿在水里，很像食物。
lines.en: Your legs in the water look very much like food.
The smell of blood has narrowed to one point.

lines.zh: 这里有条小鲨鱼，也算猎物。
lines.en: A small shark here. Prey is prey.
It is hurt and swimming with no direction.
Once chosen, the target does not change.

lines.zh: 我压低下潜，从影子下靠近。
lines.en: I sink low and approach under the shadow.

lines.zh: 海面上那块晃动的，是船。
lines.en: That rocking shape on the surface is a boat.
It is still watching me. Too late.
Only something large is worth the effort.
You cannot outswim the deep.
I follow the wake and give no inch.
You turn; I turn too, and I am larger.

lines.zh: 前面是深水，你没地方躲。
lines.en: Deep water ahead, and nowhere to hide.
Do not surface; I am up there too.
I am fastest at the moment you turn.
Your boat is taking water. I know.

lines.zh: 越来越近了，海也安静了。
lines.en: Closer now, and the sea has gone quiet.
I chase along the seabed to save strength.

lines.zh: 这一片海，没有第二条路。
lines.en: In this water there is no second route.
One bite, and the seawater turned red.
A few teeth are broken; the rest still serve.

lines.zh: 我咬住就不松，直到不动。
lines.en: I hold until it stops moving.
Your hull planks might as well be paper.

lines.zh: 这一口，是八点伤害的问候。
lines.en: That bite was a greeting worth eight points.
The blood spreads. Others will come.
Do not struggle; the water will fill your lungs.

lines.zh: 我只是尝了一口，没别的。
lines.en: I only tasted it, nothing more.

lines.zh: 骨头断的声音，我听得清。
lines.en: I hear bones break quite clearly.

lines.zh: 咬完我沉下去，慢慢等你。
lines.en: After the bite I sink and wait you out.

lines.zh: 深水一压上来，我就知道到家了。
lines.en: Deep water presses in, and I know I am home.
A temperate sea, cold enough and deep enough.

lines.zh: 我从暗处游出来，没有声音。
lines.en: I come out of the dark without a sound.
This seabed has no shark yet.

lines.zh: 一只就够，这片海容不下两只。
lines.en: One is enough; this water will not hold two.
My dorsal fin breaks the surface first.
The deep sea tastes cold and salt.

lines.zh: 我落进海里，连浪都没起。
lines.en: I entered the sea without raising a wave.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片水有主人了。
lines.en: From today, this water has a master.

lines.zh: 我慢慢下潜，下面更安静。
lines.en: I sink slowly; it is quieter below.

lines.zh: 水面上火在烧，我沉下去。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; I go under.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔回海里，很重。
lines.en: I fell back into the sea, heavily.
A shark can drown too. Do not laugh.

lines.zh: 海底一声闷响，水都推开了。
lines.en: A muffled blast below; the water shoved me aside.

lines.zh: 一支鱼叉扎进我的侧腹。
lines.en: A harpoon sank into my flank.
The seawater changed taste. It does not taste like sea.

lines.zh: 这片海空了，我饿了很久。
lines.en: This sea is empty, and I have hungered long.

lines.zh: 雷落在海面，整片水都白了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the surface; the whole sea went white.

lines.zh: 海没了，我在黑里往下坠。
lines.en: The sea is gone, and I fall through black.
